why: issue 1693 -- THE arming step of one executor's `/diagnostics` reporter, shared by `install_contract_monitors` (Rust) and nros-cpp's `nros_cpp_install_monitors` (C and C++): idempotent, arms nothing in a census run (`census_hooks::recording_run`), and never fatal when the publisher cannot be created. No rclrs counterpart -- ROS 2 has no contract monitors. See `rust:install_contract_monitors`.
